_comment: Auto-STAGE, not auto-commit (ADR-003 as amended by ADR-008).
Nix's git+file: evaluation reads a dirty tree's staged changes and skips
untracked files, so `git add` is what makes evaluation correct — the
commit never was. Committing also published unreviewed content to a
permanent public history. The old path list omitted flake.nix, flake.lock,
.devin/ and tests/, so it could not satisfy its own guarantees; `git add -A`
covers everything and .local/ is gitignored, so nothing private is staged.

hooks.command: bash -c 'if [ -d "$HOME/dotfiles/.git" ]; then cd "$HOME/dotfiles" && git add -A 2>/dev/null || true; fi'
